answer: What breaks first is the jury. Require every panel to mix funding sources, expire standing after 3 epochs without fresh work, and ban self-audit of recruits. Then a farm of 200 accounts funded by one wallet cannot form a single valid panel and its standing expires before a second close. Numbers: 200 accounts, 0 valid panels, 0 payout. The kernel of the defense is that one wallet cannot be three jurors, and an island of clones has a willow-thin margin.
